name: forester-edit
description: Keybound structural insertions (\li, \p, \tag) plus build and touch-date commands for Forester .tree files

commands.title: Forester: Insert \li{} one \ul{} out from the innermost (fresh \ul{} at end of tree if none)
Forester: Insert \li{} in a fresh \ul{} at the end of the tree
Forester: Append \p{} at end of the subtree or tree

forestEdit.buildCommand.description: Command run by "Forester: Build Forest", in the workspace folder of the active tree.

forestEdit.touchDateCommand.description: Command run by "Forester: Touch Date"; receives the active file's path as its only argument.
